usedFor: Edusign holds students and courses, and Google Docs receives each new student through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Student” in Edusign, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new student becomes a line in a tab, which suits a roster you can share.

watchOut: “New Student” in Edusign is polling, so the tab updates after a scheduled check.
